items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That was down, way down below Violet. Is it farther than Pointe?

ctx.x: Yeah. Then I had been coming up here. I had an auntie waking up on St. Charles Street, right St. Charles and Louisiana Avenue for a man from down the country down there. Well, I stayed up there with her a while before the storm. You know what I mean? I'd come and go, come and go. But I was in the country when that storm came up. And I was laying down in the bed and that 1915 storm came up. And when I seen that house on joint like that, I said, it's time for me to go. Fell apart up the rafters, huh? Yes. I mean,…
That was down, way down below Violet. Is it farther than Pointe?
Oh man, that's 30 miles down. 30 miles away. That's the place at the place called Belay. Belay. Same as these Fools called. Old man John Diamond's place.
